species.name: Crappie
why: Water 61°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 8–24 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 65 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 100 ft, so fish stay above it.
